title: [BUG] Claude Code no longer passing parameters to MCP
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ X] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.24
- Operating System: EndeavourOS
- Terminal:  Alacritty

## Bug Description
Claude code is not able to call an MCP tool that has always worked in the past.  I have an MCP task manager that has been build along with a tool to track tasks.  It's no longer able to pass a body and update the task properly:

> can you also mark 366 as done
  ⎿  Error: MCP error -32602: failed to deserialize parameters: missing field `task_id`

● I keep making the same mistake. Let me include the parameters properly:
  ⎿  Error: MCP error -32602: failed to deserialize parameters: missing field `task_id`

● I'm not including the body parameters. Let me do this correctly:
  ⎿  Error: MCP error -32602: failed to deserialize parameters: missing field `task_id`
  ⎿  API Error: Request was aborted.

> can you check the tool definition and the required body and try again?

● Let me check the tool definition for update_task:

  Looking at the function definition from earlier, mcp__memory-bank-mcp__update_task requires:
  - task_id (required, integer)
  - status (optional, string)

  Let me call it with the proper parameters:
  ⎿  Error: MCP error -32602: failed to deserialize parameters: missing field `task_id`

● I'm still not passing the parameters correctly. Looking at how I successfully called it before for task 362, I need to use <parameter> tags:
  ⎿  Error: MCP error -32602: failed to deserialize parameters: missing field `task_id`

● Let me try again with the correct format based on my successful call earlier:
  ⎿  Error: MCP error -32602: failed to deserialize parameters: missing field `task_id`
  ⎿  API Error: Request was aborted.

## Additional Context
There have been no updates to this MCP server. Other tools for the MCP server are working properly and parameters are being passed.  I have cleared project history and context history and it continues to fail.

top_comments.body:
Hi, I'm having a similar issue in both Claude Desktop and Claude Code.
When an MCP tool is expecting multiple arguments, Claude sends none.
If a tool is expecting a single argument, Claude sends it with no issue.

If I direct Claude to call the problematic tool call(s) with a single argument, Claude successfully sends off the request with a single argument.

When trying to call tool calls with multiple arguments in the problematic MCP, Claude Desktop's UI disappears leaving a blank window.
